notes.title: 1.0.2 Update Information
notes.content:
■New Multiplayer Feature: "Quick Match" Now Available!
Gone are the days of being confined to a single server for online matchups. Our new "Quick Match" feature seamlessly connects you to available teams across servers, ensuring you're always in the action.

■Player Status in Multiplayer Now Visible!
With this update, not only do you see available squads, but you can also check out everyone's status on the Avatari Squadron screen.
